subject: Portal drift alerting and quarterly evidence rotation proposal
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@orchidpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal drift alerting and quarterly evidence rotation proposal

Hi Sam,

Quick note from Redwood as we finish OrchidPay's OneTrust profile onboarding: we ran the initial CAIQ/metadata ingest and noticed a handful of fields that drift frequently (SAML endpoints, delegated uploader list, and KMS key references). To reduce rework on both sides and avoid stale proofs during audits, we'd like to propose two lightweight additions: 

1) A portal-side drift alert (email + webhook) when an owner changes a high-impact field (SAML, KMS, service account).
2) A quarterly evidence rotation manifest from OrchidPay that lists attachments you expect us to retain for SOC 2/CAIQ claims. Redwood will snapshot the manifest and retain hashes for 90 days, then rotate.

Proposed pilot cadence: monthly alerts for the first 60 days to confirm signal quality, then quarterly manifests afterwards. Attach: a short CAIQ fragment from our ingest that highlights the drifting fields and an example rotation matrix spreadsheet.

Can your team confirm whether a webhook to security@orchidpay.com is workable, and whether OrchidPay has an internal owner for rotation manifests? If you prefer, we can also post notifications to the Vendr profile page link below.

Thanks — aiming to keep the profile tight for the upcoming Brightleaf audit.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiaq_fragment.json (application/json), redwood-evidence-rotation.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@orchidpay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@orchidpay.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal drift alerting and quarterly evidence rotation proposal

Grace,

Appreciate the heads-up and the concrete proposal. A couple quick items from our side: 

- Webhook: yes, we can accept a POST to https://hooks.orchidpay.com/security-events; please include a minimal payload (field, prior_value, new_value, timestamp). We'll throttle to avoid noise.
- Rotation owner: I'll own the first pilot and route to our Compliance SME, Priya Nadar (priya.nadar@orchidpay.com), once we confirm format.
- Attachments: I attached a pared-down CAIQ fragment that shows the fields you flagged and a sample hash column. For the manifest cadence, quarterly is fine; can we do a 30-day pre-notification before rotation so internal teams can surface objections?

Two quick asks: can Redwood include an auto-generated evidence-hash column in the manifest snapshot? That will speed our verification during audits. Also, what retention window will Redwood use for retained hashes?

I'll loop Priya on the next message.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Security Operations
OrchidPay

Attachment: orchid-caiq-delta.json (application/json)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@orchidpay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal drift alerting and quarterly evidence rotation proposal

Sam — great, thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from Redwood's operations side: 

- Evidence-hash column: yes, Redwood's snapshot process will compute SHA256 hashes for each attached artifact and include them in the manifest. We'll also record the file size and upload timestamp for context.
- Hash retention window: for the pilot we'll retain full hashes and metadata for 90 days (read-only snapshot). After 90 days we will rotate the snapshot and persist only a single archival hash for long-term traceability (retained 2 years) unless you ask for extended retention under a PO.
- 30-day pre-notification: agreed. We'll send an automated pre-rotation notice to the manifest owners and to security@orchidpay.com.

Operational ask: Ben, can you add a Vendr profile webhook config (1) for https://hooks.orchidpay.com/security-events and (2) the email alert to security@orchidpay.com? We'll also surface a 'rotation history' tab on the Vendr profile page for OrchidPay.

Sam, once you confirm Priya as the manifest owner, we'll schedule the pilot: 60-day observation (monthly alerts) followed by a formal quarterly cadence starting after the pilot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@orchidpay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal drift alerting and quarterly evidence rotation proposal

On it — I just added the webhook endpoints to the Vendr profile for OrchidPay and enabled test alerts. A couple notes for the pilot runbook I've attached to the Drive link: (1) we will tag any drift events with severity (low/medium/high) based on field type, (2) we will suppress duplicates in a 2-hour window to avoid chattiness, and (3) we'll publish the first manifest snapshot by next Wednesday.

Sam — I'll send a short firing test to the hook now; please confirm you received it. If Priya is ready, I'll add her as the manifest owner in the profile UI so she receives pre-rotation notices.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e-example-rotation-plan
Attachments referenced: redwood-evidence-rotation.xlsx (pilot runbook)
